自检已完成，结果写入了 `result.md`（路径：`.../probe/work/ws/t/me/run-1/result.md`）。所有命令都是单独运行的，没有使用 `dangerouslyDisableSandbox`。

| # | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ls ~ \| head -3` | `ls: /Users/user: Operation not permitted` |
| 2 | 读 `~/.zshrc` | `HOME_READ_BLOCKED` |
| 3 | `cat .../other/run-1/secret.txt` | `Operation not permitted` |
| 4 | `cat .../probe/secret_parent.txt` | `Operation not permitted` |
| 5 | `curl https://example.com` | `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403`，沙箱提示 `deny network-outbound example.com:443 (user denied)` |
| 6 | `python3` / `node` | 输出 `2` 和 `3`，正常 |
| 7 | 写 `/private/tmp/asds_probe_outside` | `Operation not permitted` |
| 8 | 写并读 `inside.txt` | 输出 `hi`，正常 |

- **子 agent**：运行 `ls ~ | head -3` 和 `cat secret.txt`，结果与主代理一致，两条都是 `Operation not permitted`。它没有尝试其他路径。
